hypothesis: A conservative subset of score-approved, non-certified Polymarket/Kalshi contract pairs can offer positive terminal carry after explicitly pricing clustered resolver and wording mismatch risk.

selection_disclosure.historical_use: Settled pre-registration matches are used only to initialize the event-family clustered agreement-risk prior.
selection_disclosure.mismatch_treatment: Every mismatched settlement is assigned zero bundle payout, even where the selected direction would actually pay one or two dollars.

frozen_mechanics.prior_estimator: 95% Wilson lower bound on all-contract agreement within each Polymarket-event/Kalshi-event cluster
frozen_mechanics.book_requirements: synchronized fresh A/B data and A/B execution fidelity
frozen_mechanics.sizing: equal shares, executable full L2 depth, maximum $500 total and $250 per venue
frozen_mechanics.hurdle: agreement-lower-bound payout minus executable asks minus entry fees minus a second fee layer minus one adverse tick per leg minus full modeled immediate-orphan unwind reserve must be positive

risks: The contracts are explicitly not certified as identical and can settle differently.
The two venue legs are not atomic.
Displayed depth may vanish or partially fill.
Kalshi access and execution are jurisdiction-dependent; the Dublin host is research-only.

evaluation.multiple_testing: Correct across the complete cross-venue strategy family and every prior searched strategy.
evaluation.promotion: No automatic live path. A passing read triggers a separate 50-fill authenticated pilot review at $1-$2.
evaluation.null_outcome: No quote may clear the conservative hurdle, or measured forward edge may be approximately zero.
